name: GoDaddy
description: GoDaddy sells domain names, website hosting and security, and website-building, commerce and marketing tools to small businesses and individuals, mostly on annual or multi-year subscriptions with over 85% customer retention. It had 20.4 million paying customers and about 81 million domains under management at end-2025 (about 21% of the roughly 387 million registered worldwide per VeriSign). Two segments: Core Platform (domains, hosting, security; 62% of revenue) and Applications and Commerce (website builder, commerce, marketing, email; 38% and growing faster). It buys back stock heavily and pays no dividend.

employees.note: 2,414 in technology and development, 2,237 in care and services (GoDaddy Guides).

businessLines.name: Core Platform
businessLines.how: Annual or multi-year registration and renewal fees for domains, one-time aftermarket domain sales, and recurring fees for hosting and website security products.

businessLines.name: Applications and Commerce
businessLines.how: Monthly or annual subscriptions to proprietary software (website builder, commerce and payments, marketing, email and productivity) plus fees on its commerce and payments products.
